summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Ambiance Analytics Hub. All 28 backend pytest cases passed (auth, uploads idempotency, dashboard aggregations, orders list/export, exchange rates with EUR recompute, manual costs). Full UI E2E run via Playwright also passed: invalid+valid login, sidebar navigation across all 9 pages, orders CSV download, exchange rate save/revert, manual cost insert with confirmation in catalog, file-input cost upload reflected in upload history, and logout redirect to /login.

minor.issue: Defensive code at lines 697-700 has a no-op 'if/pass' block (dead code). The inner $match in pipeline already handles it. Cosmetic only.
COGS computed by iterating cursor and re-fetching every order in Python (line 668). For large datasets this is O(N); should use $lookup/aggregate. Works for current ~7k rows.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/uploads.py, routers/dashboard.py, services/parsers.py for maintainability.
PUT /api/exchange-rates recomputes line_total_eur with per-document update_one in a loop (one round-trip per order). For 7k+ orders this is slow; use bulk_write with UpdateOne operations.
Cost lookup in summary/top-skus/profit-loss loads ALL costs into memory each call (costs_map dict). Fine now but should be cached or joined via $lookup.

build_match always sets order_date_iso $gte/$lte as ISO date strings — works because data stored as ISO strings, but mixing string compare with $ne None checks (lines 697-705) is fragile. Trend pipeline relies on $dateFromString fallback if order_date_iso is null.
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. Set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in production.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook calls for lockout after 5 fails).
seed_data_creation: Tests upload /app/sample_data/{channelengine.csv, beezup.xlsx, amazon_po.xls}. ChannelEngine re-upload verified idempotent (inserted=0). Test cost SKUs (TEST_SKU_001/002/MANUAL_001/UI_SKU_001) created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py runs in ~13s and exercises every documented endpoint. To re-run: `cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_api.py -v`. Sample data lives in /app/sample_data. Note: the idempotency test asserts inserted==0 on re-upload, so it relies on the previous test having inserted rows first (same test session).
